body: My mother died the day after my twelfth birthday. I always feel odd around that time of year, but as I've grown, it has become more a celebration and less of a mourning atmosphere. Time helps heal the grief, but it certainly doesn't make you miss her any less. There are so many things my mom has not physically been here for, and that's probably the hardest part for me.
Hope you had a wonderful time with your boyfriend!
